purpose: Compare clusters across standardized business-relevant profile variables.
key_message: Clusters differ meaningfully in income, spending, purchases, household structure, campaign acceptance, and response.

purpose: Show the size and percentage of each customer segment.
key_message: The four retained clusters are reasonably sized, from about 19% to 30% of customers.

purpose: Compare each cluster on interpretable business metrics.
key_message: Cluster 0 stands out as high-income/high-spend; clusters 1 and 3 are lower-spend but differ in household structure; cluster 2 is family-heavy with strong purchasing.

purpose: Show whether segment membership aligns with different response rates.
key_message: Cluster 0 had the highest response rate, while Cluster 3 had the lowest.

purpose: Compare best model performance for A, B, and C feature sets.
key_message: Adding cluster did not improve prediction; adding historical campaign summaries improved performance.

purpose: Compare strongest model-feature-set combinations by PR-AUC and F1.
key_message: The best PR-AUC came from Feature Set C with balanced logistic regression.

purpose: Show precision, recall, F1, false positives, and false negatives across thresholds.
key_message: Lower thresholds catch more responders but create more false positives; higher thresholds are more precise but miss more responders.

purpose: Summarize the project workflow from raw data to final findings.
key_message: The project combines segmentation and supervised prediction in a structured data science workflow.
